packageRules.description: The e2e job runs in the Playwright image, whose tag must equal the @playwright/test version in package-lock.json (scripts/check-playwright-image.mjs fails CI otherwise), so Renovate bumps both in one PR. Listed here, after the shared preset's rules, so it wins over the all-non-major group.
Hold the postgres Docker image on 18, the version CI runs (.github/workflows/ci.yaml). Postgres 19 is not adopted yet.
Hold @electric-sql/pglite below 0.6.0, which embeds PostgreSQL 19 and would move the tests off the Postgres 18 held above.
